ruling: - **R22. A respawn rewrites every session id at once.** Owner 19:19 CST Nov 10, on home's move to a new account: "its moreso that a session ended coordinwtor and all and a new coordinator and sessions respawned and somehow no one rewrote the session ids to now be the new ones". Outcome: an answer wakes a dead session, and the owner has to ask who does the work. 1. Cause (read on main): skill project-ops keeps the roster in the claude.ai project instructions, "so keep no second copy in the repo". No session can write there, so sessions copy ids into page items and briefs, and nothing rewrites those copies. 2. The roster moves to the record branch, where triage writes it. The session that starts a standing session or lane sends triage the new id in the same turn. Triage rewrites that roster line. 3. A page item, brief or handoff names a lane slug or role, never a session id (CLAUDE.md git-slug-then-claim-number already says so for lanes). The wake path reads the id from the roster when it sends. A guard refuses a page write that stores a session id. 4. Fits R18 point 2: each item names who wakes, by slug or role. Home: skill project-ops; skill waiting-page.
